title: Cryptocurrency Denomination and NFT Pricing
title_zh: 加密货币计价与NFT定价
title_primary: 加密货币计价与NFT定价

authors: Jaehyeong Park, Euro Bae, Daegon Cho, Donghoon Kim
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using transaction data from OpenSea, we examine whether NFT market participants anchor pricing decisions to nominal ETH-denominated transaction histories, rather than their fluctuating dollar values, across sequential stages: price setting (purchase-to-list) and price taking (list-to-sale). Panel regressions on 46,671 repeated NFT sales reveal that sellers anchor listing prices to acquisition prices, generating asymmetric mark-ups during ETH appreciation and mark-downs during ETH depreciation. Buyers exhibit similar anchoring realized prices. Stablecoin-denominated acquisition prices partially mitigate these distortions. These findings extend the denomination and anchoring literature to highly volatile, multi-currency marketplaces.

title: The value of trademarks
title_zh: 商标的价值
title_primary: 商标的价值
title_secondary: The value of trademarks
authors: Pranav Desai, Ekaterina Gavrilova, Rui C. Silva, Margarida Soares
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We create a new measure of the value of an important, but previously understudied, intangible asset —trademarks. We quantify the stock market reaction to the publication of individual trademarks manually matched to U.S. publicly traded firms. We find that trademarks are used ubiquitously and possess substantial value: the median trademark is worth $20 million. Firms that obtain new trademarks subsequently launch new products, increase sales, invest more in physical capital, hire more employees, increase production output, become more profitable, and increase their market share considerably. For identification, we exploit the quasi-random assignment of USPTO examining attorneys to trademarks.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一种衡量重要但此前研究不足的无形资产——商标价值的新方法。通过将美国上市公司与个别商标的公开信息进行手工匹配，我们量化了商标公布时的股市反应。研究发现，商标被广泛使用且具有显著价值：中位数商标价值达2000万美元。获得新商标的企业随后会推出新产品、增加销售额、加大实物资本投资、扩充员工队伍、提升生产产出、增强盈利能力，并显著扩大市场份额。为识别因果关系，我们利用了美国专利商标局审查律师对商标的准随机分配机制。

title: Immigration enforcement and safety net participation in mixed-status households
title_zh: 移民执法与混合身份家庭中的安全网参与
title_primary: 移民执法与混合身份家庭中的安全网参与
title_secondary: Immigration enforcement and safety net participation in mixed-status households
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies how immigration enforcement shapes participation in safety net programs within mixed-status households. I examine the program participation responses of Hispanic citizens living with individuals facing deportation risk following the enactment of E-Verify mandates, an employment-based immigration enforcement policy targeting undocumented immigrants. Using a difference-in-differences framework, I find that E-Verify mandates reduced household income. Participation responses differ across programs—Medicaid, the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), and Supplemental Security Income (SSI). While SSI participation temporarily increased and SNAP participation remained stable, Medicaid participation declined sharply. The decline in Medicaid participation is more pronounced among groups whose household members face higher deportation risk, consistent with chilling effects limiting program take-up.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了移民执法如何影响混合身份家庭中安全网项目的参与情况。我考察了在实施E-Verify强制令（一项针对无证移民的基于就业的移民执法政策）后，与面临遣返风险的个人同住的西班牙裔公民的项目参与反应。利用双重差分框架，我发现E-Verify强制令降低了家庭收入。不同项目的参与反应各异——医疗补助、补充营养援助计划（SNAP）和补充保障收入（SSI）。虽然SSI参与暂时增加且SNAP参与保持稳定，但医疗补助参与急剧下降。医疗补助参与的下降在家庭成员面临更高遣返风险的群体中更为显著，这与寒蝉效应限制项目参与的现象一致。

title: A Long-Run Perspective on Unconditional Convergence in Manufacturing: Evidence from U.S. Industrialization
title_zh: 美国工业化证据：制造业无条件趋同的长期视角
title_primary: 美国工业化证据：制造业无条件趋同的长期视角
title_secondary: A Long-Run Perspective on Unconditional Convergence in Manufacturing: Evidence from U.S. Industrialization
authors: Alexander Klein, Miguel León-Ledesma, Nicholas Crafts
official: 官方在线 2025-07-24 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines long-run unconditional convergence of labour productivity in manufacturing across 48 contiguous U.S. states. We construct a detailed panel data set of state-industry pairs with over 120 industries covering the period 1880-2007. The remarkable finding is a rapid rate of unconditional β-convergence: 7.6% per year in the period 1880-2007, and about 6.5% in each period 1880-1940 and 1958-2007. We also find a steep rise in unconditional convergence from 5.5% in 1930-1940 to 10.6% in 1940-1947 and 9.4% in 1947-1958, followed by a considerable drop thereafter. In the years 1958-2007, the rate of convergence in ICT industries (8.3%) is higher than in 1st-Industrial-Revolution (6.3%) or 2nd-Industrial-Revolution (7.0%) industries. We interpret our results as a process of technological catch up between initially laggard Southern manufacturing and manufacturing industries in the North.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国本土48个州制造业劳动生产率在长期内的无条件收敛情况。我们构建了一个包含超过120个行业、覆盖1880年至2007年的州-行业配对详细面板数据集。显著发现是快速的无条件β-收敛率：在1880年至2007年间为每年7.6%，而在1880年至1940年及1958年至2007年各时期约为每年6.5%。我们还发现，无条件收敛率在1930年至1940年的5.5%急剧上升至1940年至1947年的10.6%及1947年至1958年的9.4%，此后则显著下降。在1958年至2007年间，信息通信技术行业的收敛率（8.3%）高于第一次工业革命行业（6.3%）或第二次工业革命行业（7.0%）。我们将结果解释为初始落后的南方制造业与北方制造业之间技术追赶的过程。

title: Defense Spending, Cost of Living, and the Optimal Exchange Rate Regime during Wartime in Ukraine
title_zh: 战时乌克兰的国防支出、生活成本与最优汇率制度
title_primary: 战时乌克兰的国防支出、生活成本与最优汇率制度
title_secondary: Defense Spending, Cost of Living, and the Optimal Exchange Rate Regime during Wartime in Ukraine
official: 官方在线 2026-05-19 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Were either the exceptional defense spending needs of the government or the sharp increase in the cost-of-living of poorer households factors that rationalize the National Bank of Ukraine’s temporary fix of the Hryvnia when Russia invaded in 2022? To test the validity of these explanations, we develop a small open-economy two-agent New Keynesian (SOE-TANK) model of Ukraine featuring: 1) a government that finances military imports and 2) low- and high-income households. We find that the surge in foreign-currency-denominated military spending alone does not justify a temporary exchange-rate peg. However, when the consumption of low income households is close to subsistence levels, we find that the optimal exchange rate regime becomes state-contingent: exchange-rate flexibility is desirable for small shocks, whereas for a large-scale invasion shock, a fixed exchange rate dominates a floating regime with a standard Taylor rule.
abstract_zh: 政府异常庞大的国防开支需求，或是贫困家庭生活成本急剧上升，是否构成了乌克兰国家银行在2022年俄罗斯入侵时临时固定赫里夫尼亚汇率的合理依据？为检验这些解释的有效性，我们构建了一个乌克兰的小型开放经济双主体新凯恩斯主义（SOE-TANK）模型，该模型包含：1）一个为军事进口融资的政府；2）低收入与高收入家庭。研究发现，仅以外币计价的军事支出激增并不足以证明临时汇率挂钩的合理性。然而，当低收入家庭的消费接近生存水平时，最优汇率制度变得依状态而定：对于小规模冲击，汇率灵活性更为可取；而对于大规模入侵冲击，固定汇率则优于采用标准泰勒规则的浮动汇率制度。

abstract: We develop a Heterogeneous Agent New Keynesian model of two countries (HANK²) and show in closed form that a monetary union shifts the adjustment to a shock horizontally - across countries - within the brackets of the union-wide wealth distribution rather than vertically - that is, across the brackets of the union-wide wealth distribution. Calibrating the model to the euro area reveals that a monetary union alters the impact of shocks most strongly in the tails of the wealth distribution but leaves the middle class almost unaffected.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个两国异质性主体新凯恩斯模型（HANK²），并以闭式解形式证明，货币联盟将冲击的调整方式从纵向——即跨越联盟整体财富分布的各层级——转变为横向——即在联盟内各国之间进行。将该模型校准至欧元区数据后发现，货币联盟对财富分布尾部的冲击影响最为显著，而对中产阶级几乎无影响。

title: One Click Away: AI Tutoring with Khanmigo in a Two-Year School Experiment
title_zh: 一键之遥：Khanmigo人工智能辅导在两年制学校实验中的应用
title_primary: 一键之遥：Khanmigo人工智能辅导在两年制学校实验中的应用
title_secondary: One Click Away: AI Tutoring with Khanmigo in a Two-Year School Experiment
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Generative AI has been promoted as the technology that could transform education by providing every student a personal tutor. We provide some of the first large-scale experimental evidence, from a two-year cluster randomized trial in 18 Tennessee middle schools in which randomly assigned students used Khan Academy with its AI tutor, Khanmigo, configured to coach rather than give answers, during existing daily remedial mathematics sessions. Assignment raises math achievement by 1.3 national percentile ranks per term, or about 0.06 to 0.08 standard deviations over a school year; the implied effect of a full year of active participation reaches 0.14 standard deviations. These gains resemble those from Khan Academy practice without AI assistance. One explanation is that students used the tutor infrequently and, when they did, rarely engaged it in substantive mathematical dialogue: 96 percent of students tried Khanmigo at least once, but the median student messaged it on only a third of the days they practiced, and in only 17 percent of the exercise sessions in which they made a mistake. Messages that students did send were mostly bare answers or clicks on suggested prompts. The binding constraint appears to be engagement: realizing the promise of AI tutoring will require getting students to use it, not just giving them access.
abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能被推崇为一项能够通过为每位学生提供个性化导师来变革教育的科技。我们提供了首批大规模实验证据之一，来自一项为期两年的整群随机试验，在田纳西州18所中学进行，随机分配的学生在现有的每日补救性数学课程中使用可汗学院及其AI导师Khanmigo，该导师被配置为引导而非直接给出答案。分配使用使数学成绩每学期提升1.3个全国百分位排名，或相当于一学年内约0.06至0.08个标准差；全年积极参与的隐含效应达到0.14个标准差。这些收益与无AI辅助的可汗学院练习效果相似。一个解释是，学生使用该导师的频率较低，且即便使用，也很少进行实质性的数学对话：96%的学生至少尝试过Khanmigo，但中位数学生在练习日仅有三分之一的天数向其发送信息，且在犯错时的练习环节中，仅17%的环节进行了互动。学生发送的信息大多为直接答案或点击建议提示。制约因素似乎是参与度：实现AI辅导的潜力需要让学生真正使用它，而不仅仅是提供访问机会。

title: The Displacement Effects of Domestic Outsourcing
title_zh: 国内外包的替代效应
title_primary: 国内外包的替代效应
title_secondary: The Displacement Effects of Domestic Outsourcing
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Evidence that domestic outsourcing lowers pay comes largely from on-site transfers, in which workers move to a contractor but keep the same jobs. Displacement is rarely observed: whether workers lose their jobs, where they go, how earnings evolve. In Brazil’s 1993–1994 pro-outsourcing reforms, which differentially affected security guards, such transfers were rare; firms instead used occupational layoffs, shedding their guards while keeping other workers. Displaced guards’ employment recovered within five years, but many changed occupations and wages stayed about 12% lower. Lifetime losses average 1.2 to 1.5 years of pre-layoff earnings, concentrated among workers from high-wage firms, reflecting lost premia.
abstract_zh: 关于国内外包降低薪酬的证据，主要来源于现场转移案例，即工人转至承包商处工作但岗位不变。而工人失业、去向及收入变化等位移现象则鲜有观察。在巴西1993至1994年的促进外包改革中，该政策对保安人员产生了差异化影响，此类转移情况罕见；企业反而采取职业性裁员，解雇保安而保留其他员工。被裁保安的就业状况在五年内得以恢复，但许多人转换了职业，工资水平仍低约12%。终身损失平均相当于裁员前收入的1.2至1.5年，且集中于来自高工资企业的工人，反映了失去的溢价。

title: Platform Power in News Aggregation
title_zh: 新闻聚合中的平台权力
title_primary: 新闻聚合中的平台权力
title_secondary: Platform Power in News Aggregation
authors: Andrey Simonov, Daniil Mikhailov, Ruben Enikolopov, Ruben Durante
official: 官方在线 2026-07-26 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: News aggregators are among the primary gatekeepers of online news, shaping both consumption and production through the algorithms that rank stories and sources. We provide the first large scale estimates of this algorithmic power using the example of Yandex News, Russia’s largest aggregator. Combining archived front pages with 12.3 million published articles and outlet-level traffic data, we estimate that occupying the entire top-5 news block for a day raises an outlet’s traffic by roughly 380,000 visitors. After a 2016 law made aggregators liable for cited content, Yandex halved its references to independent outlets, yet consumers did not penalize the manipulation: its referrals converted readers at the same rate, and its market share did not fall. Removed outlets shifted toward longer articles and stopped optimizing headlines for the algorithm, showing that aggregator algorithms shape not only news consumption but also production.
abstract_zh: 新闻聚合器是在线新闻的主要守门人，通过排序报道和来源的算法，同时塑造新闻消费与生产。我们以俄罗斯最大的聚合器Yandex News为例，首次大规模估算了这种算法的影响力。结合存档首页、1230万篇已发表文章以及媒体层面的流量数据，我们估算出，占据前五名新闻板块一整天可使一家媒体的流量增加约38万访客。2016年一项法律要求聚合器对引用的内容负责后，Yandex将独立媒体的引用量减半，但消费者并未惩罚这种操纵：其引荐的读者转化率保持不变，市场份额也未下降。被移除的媒体转向发布更长的文章，并停止为算法优化标题，这表明聚合器算法不仅塑造新闻消费，也影响新闻生产。

abstract: During a distinguished career that spanned more than five decades, Assaf Razin, who passed away in July 2026, established himself as one of the leading international economists of his generation. This column describes how, across a range of topics including international trade, international finance, fiscal policy, taxation, migration, the welfare state, and financial crises, he combined theoretical innovation with an abiding concern for policy and for the ways in which globalisation expands national opportunities while constraining national choices.
abstract_zh: 在跨越五十余载的杰出学术生涯中，于2026年7月逝世的阿萨夫·拉津（Assaf Razin）奠定了其作为同代顶尖国际经济学家的地位。本专栏将阐述他如何在国际贸易、国际金融、财政政策、税收、移民、福利国家及金融危机等一系列议题中，将理论创新与对政策的持久关注相结合，并深入探讨全球化如何在拓展国家机遇的同时约束国家选择。

title: Beyond the First Bond: Market Access and Debt Dynamics in Frontier Economies
title_zh: 超越首次债券：前沿经济体的市场准入与债务动态
title_primary: 超越首次债券：前沿经济体的市场准入与债务动态
title_secondary: Beyond the First Bond: Market Access and Debt Dynamics in Frontier Economies
official: 官方在线 2026-07-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine market entry and post-entry debt dynamics in Frontier Economies by grouping countries based on durability of market access using a two-step framework combining first Eurobond issuance with the reliance on private external creditors, validated through an unsupervised K-mean clustering. A discrete-time event LOGIT model finds that favorable global liquidity conditions and investor appetite open issuance windows for countries, but domestic pull factors—income, institutions, growth, and reserve buffers—ultimately determine success of market entry. Post-entry, Frontier Economies shift rapidly toward market borrowing, with looser fiscal stance as new financing source is unlocked. Along increased exposure to rollover and global financial cycle risks, debt decomposition exercise shows a worsening interest–growth differential and rising debt, driven mainly by primary deficits and higher interest burdens. Results underscore the need for credible medium-term fiscal frameworks, stronger debt management, and reserve buffers to manage the transition to market financing.
abstract_zh: 我们通过两步法框架，将国家按市场准入的持久性进行分组，结合首次欧元债券发行与对私人外部债权人的依赖程度，并借助无监督K均值聚类进行验证，从而考察前沿经济体的市场进入及进入后的债务动态。离散时间事件LOGIT模型发现，有利的全球流动性条件和投资者偏好为各国打开了发行窗口，但国内拉动因素——收入水平、制度质量、经济增长和储备缓冲——最终决定了市场进入的成功与否。进入市场后，前沿经济体迅速转向市场借贷，随着新融资来源的解锁，财政政策趋于宽松。在面临展期风险和全球金融周期风险加剧的同时，债务分解分析显示，利息-增长差恶化且债务上升，主要源于基本赤字和更高的利息负担。研究结果强调了建立可信的中期财政框架、加强债务管理以及储备缓冲的必要性，以应对向市场融资的转型。

title: Stanley Fischer Memorial Lecture: Public Debt and Central Banks — The World Bank Group ABCDE Conference
title_zh: 斯坦利·费希尔纪念讲座：公共债务与中央银行——世界银行集团ABCDE会议
title_primary: 斯坦利·费希尔纪念讲座：公共债务与中央银行——世界银行集团ABCDE会议
title_secondary: Stanley Fischer Memorial Lecture: Public Debt and Central Banks — The World Bank Group ABCDE Conference
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper, based on the Stanley Fischer Memorial Lecture that the author delivered at the Annual Bank Conference on Development Economics (ABCDE) 2026, examines two structural impediments to broad-based economic development: dysfunctional central bank currency systems and inadequately resolved sovereign debt burdens. On currency, the paper argues that floating exchange rate regimes and multiple exchange rate systems—as practiced in countries such as Ethiopia, Nigeria, and Egypt—systematically transfer wealth from low-income wage earners to a narrow-privileged class, deepening poverty rather than alleviating it. Using Ethiopia as a central case study, the paper documents how successive devaluations have raised the national poverty rate from 33 percent in 2016 to a projected 43 percent by 2025, while eroding the real value of development assistance disbursed in local currency. The paper proposes that currency stabilization, low-cost digital payment infrastructure, and unsterilized central bank intervention offer a more direct path to rising median incomes than current IMF-endorsed exchange rate flexibility. On sovereign debt, the paper evaluates the performance of the G20 Common Framework and the Global Sovereign Debt Roundtable against the benchmark of the 1989 Brady Plan, finding that contemporary frameworks have generated intensive creditor engagement but minimal net present value reduction for debtor countries. Key failures identified include the absence of a single comparable discount rate for measuring debt relief, incomplete participation by China and commercial creditors, growing opacity in collateralized sovereign transactions, and the risks posed by value recovery instruments to the durability of restructuring agreements. The paper concludes that neither the Common Framework nor the Global Sovereign Debt Roundtable, in their current forms, are fit for purpose, and calls for replacement frameworks that prioritize measurable median income gains over creditor accommodation. Absent reforms on both fronts, per capita income growth in low-income developing economies is projected to remain at approximately 2 percent annually, leaving 5.6 billion people with incomes less than one-tenth of those in advanced economies and widening the global development gap.
abstract_zh: 本文基于作者在2026年发展经济学年度银行会议（ABCDE）上发表的斯坦利·费希尔纪念演讲，探讨了阻碍广泛经济发展的两大结构性障碍：功能失调的央行货币体系与未充分解决的主权债务负担。在货币方面，本文指出，浮动汇率制度及多重汇率体系——如埃塞俄比亚、尼日利亚和埃及等国所实行的制度——系统性地将财富从低收入工薪阶层转移至少数特权阶层，加剧而非缓解贫困。以埃塞俄比亚为核心案例，本文记录了连续贬值如何使全国贫困率从2016年的33%上升至2025年预计的43%，同时侵蚀了以本币拨付的发展援助的实际价值。本文提出，相较于当前国际货币基金组织认可的汇率弹性政策，货币稳定、低成本数字支付基础设施及未冲销的央行干预措施，为提升中位收入提供了更直接的路径。在主权债务方面，本文以1989年布雷迪计划为基准，评估了二十国集团共同框架与全球主权债务圆桌会议的表现，发现当代框架虽促成了密集的债权人参与，但对债务国而言净现值削减微乎其微。识别出的关键失败包括：缺乏衡量债务减免的统一可比贴现率、中国及商业债权人参与不完整、抵押主权交易日益不透明，以及价值回收工具对重组协议持久性构成的威胁。本文结论认为，共同框架与全球主权债务圆桌会议目前的形式均不适用，并呼吁建立以可衡量的中位收入增长而非债权人妥协为核心的替代框架。若这两方面改革缺失，低收入发展中经济体的人均收入增长预计将维持在每年约2%的水平，导致56亿人口的收入不足发达经济体的十分之一，从而扩大全球发展差距。

title: Additionality and Asymmetric Information in Environmental Markets: Evidence from Conservation Auctions
title_zh: 环境市场中的额外性与信息不对称：来自保护拍卖的证据
title_primary: 环境市场中的额外性与信息不对称：来自保护拍卖的证据
title_secondary: Additionality and Asymmetric Information in Environmental Markets: Evidence from Conservation Auctions
official: 卷期日期 2026-08-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Mechanisms that aim to reduce environmental degradation at low cost can be undermined when participants’ conservation actions are not marginal to the incentive — or “additional” — as the lowest-cost participants may not be the highest social value. We investigate this challenge in the Conservation Reserve Program’s auction mechanism for ecosystem services, linking bids to satellite-derived land use. Three-quarters of marginal auction winners are not additional. The heterogeneity in counterfactual land use introduces adverse selection. We develop a model of bidding and additionality to quantify welfare implications. Alternative auctions increase efficiency by using scoring rules that incorporate expected land use impacts.
abstract_zh: 旨在以低成本减少环境退化的机制，当参与者的保护行为并非激励的边际效应——即“额外性”——时，可能会被削弱，因为成本最低的参与者可能并非社会价值最高的。我们在保护储备计划的生态系统服务拍卖机制中研究这一挑战，将投标与卫星衍生的土地利用联系起来。四分之三的边际拍卖获胜者不具备额外性。反事实土地利用的异质性引入了逆向选择。我们构建了一个投标与额外性模型，以量化福利影响。替代性拍卖通过采用纳入预期土地利用影响的评分规则来提高效率。

title: Going Viral: Protests and Polarization in 1932 Hamburg,
title_zh: 病毒式传播：1932年汉堡的抗议与极化
title_primary: 病毒式传播：1932年汉堡的抗议与极化
title_secondary: Going Viral: Protests and Polarization in 1932 Hamburg,
authors: Bruno Caprettini, Marcel Caesmann, Hans-Joachim Voth, David Yanagizawa-Drott
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Political polarization is a growing concern in many countries. Are mass protests merely a sign of increasing cleavages, or do they polarize societies? In this paper, we estimate the impact of Nazi marches in 1932 Hamburg, using granular data from 622 voting precincts during 6 elections. We show propaganda can persuade – but it does by raising the share of areas with high levels of Nazi support. Importantly, marches can also backfire, repelling voters. Thus, protest marches lead to polarization. These effects diffused through social networks, measured as contagion patterns across neighborhoods from the 1918 Spanish flu outbreak. The electoral effects of social spillovers are of similar importance as direct exposure, and grow over time.
abstract_zh: 摘要 政治极化已成为多国日益严峻的挑战。大规模抗议究竟是社会裂痕加剧的表征，还是导致社会极化的动因？本文利用1932年汉堡622个投票区在六次选举中的微观数据，评估纳粹游行的影响。研究表明，宣传具有说服力——但其作用机制在于提升纳粹支持率较高区域的占比。关键在于，游行也可能产生反效果，即疏远选民。因此，抗议游行最终导致社会极化。这些效应通过社会网络扩散，其传播模式可通过1918年西班牙流感期间跨社区传染路径进行测度。社会溢出效应带来的选举影响与直接接触效应同等重要，且随时间推移持续增强。

title: From Minor Ailments to Major Illnesses: A Practical Framework for Valuing Morbidity in Environmental Policy Analysis
title_zh: 从轻微不适到重大疾病：环境政策分析中疾病负担评估的实用框架
title_primary: 从轻微不适到重大疾病：环境政策分析中疾病负担评估的实用框架
title_secondary: From Minor Ailments to Major Illnesses: A Practical Framework for Valuing Morbidity in Environmental Policy Analysis
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Environmental decisions often impact health, yet morbidity valuation remains challenging, with current approaches like cost-of-illness (COI) measures and Quality-Adjusted Life Years failing to reflect individuals’ willingness to pay to avoid adverse health states. This paper introduces a novel framework for valuing morbidity across health conditions, deriving willingness-to-pay (WTP) estimates using widely available preference weights and a baseline condition with known WTP. Our analysis reveals WTP estimates significantly exceeding commonly used COI measures, indicating undervaluation of health states in policy evaluations. Sensitivity analyses highlight variations consistent with those for the value of statistical life, underscoring the method's robustness. This framework offers a practical tool for integrating morbidity into analyses of environmental policy.
abstract_zh: 环境决策常影响健康，但疾病负担的估值仍面临挑战。当前的成本-疾病法（COI）和质量调整生命年等指标未能反映个体为避免不良健康状态而愿意支付的金额。本文提出一种跨健康状况评估疾病负担的新框架，通过广泛可用的偏好权重和已知支付意愿的基准健康状况，推导出支付意愿（WTP）估计值。分析显示，WTP估计值显著高于常用的COI指标，表明政策评估中健康状态被低估。敏感性分析揭示了与统计生命价值一致的变异特征，凸显了该方法的稳健性。该框架为将疾病负担纳入环境政策分析提供了实用工具。

title: Optimal sender ordering in sequential persuasion
title_zh: 序列说服中的最优发送者排序
title_primary: 序列说服中的最优发送者排序
title_secondary: Optimal sender ordering in sequential persuasion
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies the impact of the order of senders in a sequential Bayesian persuasion game on the receiver’s equilibrium utility. We find that it is always optimal for the receiver to put the more aligned sender before the less aligned sender. Comparative statics analysis shows that when we restrict to senders who are comparable (i.e., a sender is more aligned than the other sender), as the degree of misalignment between senders increases or as the number of senders increases, the receiver’s equilibrium utility may (weakly) decrease. In addition, we find that when senders are comparable, the sequential game performs no worse than the simultaneous game in terms of information disclosure.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了序贯贝叶斯说服博弈中发送者顺序对接收者均衡效用的影响。我们发现，将更契合的发送者置于较不契合的发送者之前，对接收者而言总是最优的。比较静态分析表明，当限制在可比较的发送者之间（即一个发送者比另一个更契合）时，随着发送者间不契合程度的增加或发送者数量的增加，接收者的均衡效用可能（弱）下降。此外，我们发现当发送者可比较时，序贯博弈在信息披露方面不劣于同时博弈。

title: From means-tested programs to Universal Basic Income - The role of endogenous participation in transfer programs
title_zh: 从经济状况调查项目到全民基本收入——转移支付项目中内生参与的作用
title_primary: 从经济状况调查项目到全民基本收入——转移支付项目中内生参与的作用
title_secondary: From means-tested programs to Universal Basic Income - The role of endogenous participation in transfer programs
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies the effects of replacing the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) with a Universal Basic Income (UBI) in an environment where EITC take-up is incomplete. In contrast, UBI ensures full participation by design, extending benefits to households who do not take up the EITC, at the cost of higher fiscal expenditures. I study this trade-off between expanded coverage and fiscal cost using a life-cycle model with an endogenous EITC participation decision that replicates the observed eligibility and take-up patterns. The results show that a generous UBI ($12,000 annually) reduces welfare due to the substantial fiscal burden it entails, whereas a modest UBI ($3500 per year) improves welfare by reaching previously uncovered households at only a moderate fiscal cost. These findings highlight the importance of the program participation margin in evaluating policy reforms.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在劳动所得税抵免（EITC）参与不完全的环境下，以全民基本收入（UBI）替代劳动所得税抵免的影响。相比之下，UBI通过设计确保全面参与，将福利延伸至未参与EITC的家庭，但代价是更高的财政支出。我通过一个包含内生EITC参与决策的生命周期模型来研究扩大覆盖范围与财政成本之间的权衡，该模型能够复现观察到的资格与参与模式。结果表明，慷慨的UBI（每年12，000美元）因伴随的巨额财政负担而降低福利，而适度的UBI（每年3，500美元）则通过以适度的财政成本惠及此前未被覆盖的家庭来改善福利。这些发现凸显了项目参与边际在评估政策改革中的重要性。

title: Achieving win–win outcomes in productivity and pollution abatement through environmental tax reform: evidence from China
title_zh: 通过环境税改革实现生产率与污染减排的双赢：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 通过环境税改革实现生产率与污染减排的双赢：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Achieving win–win outcomes in productivity and pollution abatement through environmental tax reform: evidence from China
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper exploits China’s Environmental Protection Tax Reform (CEPTR) as a quasi-natural experiment to examine whether market-based environmental regulation can simultaneously enhance productivity and reduce pollution. Using panel data on A-share listed firms over the period 2012–2024 and a difference-in-differences (DID) framework, we evaluate the reform’s impact on firms’ total factor productivity (TFP) and pollutant emissions. The results reveal a clear ‘double dividend’ effect: CEPTR significantly increases TFP while simultaneously reducing emissions. Mechanism analyses indicate that these effects are primarily driven by three channels: the promotion of green innovation, increased R&D investment and the alleviation of financing constraints. Heterogeneity analysis shows that firms in moderately polluting industries experience the most pronounced improvements in both productivity and emission reduction, suggesting that the reform is particularly effective where regulatory pressure is neither too weak nor excessively stringent. Overall, the findings provide firm-level evidence supporting the Porter Hypothesis in the context of a major developing economy and highlight the role of environmental taxation as an effective policy instrument for achieving coordinated economic and environmental gains.
abstract_zh: 本文利用中国环境保护税改革（CEPTR）作为准自然实验，考察基于市场的环境规制能否同时提升生产率并减少污染。基于2012—2024年A股上市公司面板数据及双重差分（DID）框架，我们评估了该改革对企业全要素生产率（TFP）和污染物排放的影响。研究结果揭示了明显的“双重红利”效应：CEPTR显著提高了TFP，同时减少了排放。机制分析表明，这些效应主要通过三条渠道实现：促进绿色创新、增加研发投入以及缓解融资约束。异质性分析显示，中度污染行业的企业在生产率提升和减排方面均表现出最显著的改善，这表明改革在监管压力既不过弱也不过强的情境下尤为有效。总体而言，本文的研究发现为波特假说在大型发展中经济体的适用性提供了企业层面的证据，并凸显了环境税作为实现经济与环境协同增效的有效政策工具的作用。

title: Infrastructure or Knowledge? Investment Priorities for Promoting the Adoption of Digital Health Tools
title_zh: 基础设施还是知识？促进数字健康工具采纳的投资优先序
title_primary: 基础设施还是知识？促进数字健康工具采纳的投资优先序
title_secondary: Infrastructure or Knowledge? Investment Priorities for Promoting the Adoption of Digital Health Tools
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: As COVID-19 pandemic accelerated the digitalization of healthcare, prompting large public investments in the sector, it remains unclear whether the initial shock generated a stable adoption of digital health tools and the full exploitation of their functionalities. Using the case of the Electronic Health Records (EHR) in Italy, we show that a remarkable increase in its use in the aftermath of the pandemic is not necessarily associated to an equal understanding of its scope and functions by potential patients. Exploiting a 2020 reform and variation in pandemic exposure, we show that a one-standard- deviation increase in exposure increased EHR reported use by 39%, driven by records feeding and medical needs. We then leverage a December 2024 national media campaign on the EHR to conduct an original survey focused on its adoption. Among the main evidence is that the acknowledgment of the EHR existence does not translate into effective knowledge, access, or regular use. Engagement is more strongly associated with trust and digital attitudes than with most traditional socio-economic factors. Progress along the adoption chain depends on perceived needs, institutional confidence, and willingness to engage with digital tools. To provide an understanding of how to increase perceived benefits and willingness to engage with the EHR, we randomize information treatments based on the Technology Acceptance Model. Overall, our findings suggest that the effectiveness of large-scale digital health investments depends critically on citizens' awareness, trust, and engagement, and that more tailored information campaigns are needed to improve the general literacy of digital tools once they are introduced or potentiated.
abstract_zh: 随着新冠疫情加速医疗数字化进程并推动该领域大规模公共投资，尚不明确的是，这一初始冲击是否催生了数字健康工具的稳定采用及其功能的充分开发。以意大利电子健康档案（EHR）为例，我们发现疫情后其使用量显著增长，但潜在患者对其范围与功能的认知未必同步提升。利用2020年改革及疫情暴露程度的差异，我们证明疫情暴露程度每增加一个标准差，EHR报告使用率将提升39%，这一增长主要由记录录入和医疗需求驱动。随后，我们借助2024年12月全国性EHR媒体宣传活动开展了一项聚焦其采纳情况的原创调查。主要证据表明：对EHR存在的认知并未转化为有效知识、实际访问或常规使用。相较于大多数传统社会经济因素，用户参与度与信任度及数字态度关联更为紧密。采纳链条的推进取决于感知需求、制度信心及数字工具使用意愿。为理解如何提升EHR的感知收益与使用意愿，我们基于技术接受模型随机分配信息干预。总体而言，研究结果表明：大规模数字健康投资的有效性关键取决于公民的认知、信任与参与度，且需通过更具针对性的信息宣传活动，在数字工具引入或强化后提升公众对其的普遍素养。

title: Drafting and Free-Riding in Mass-Start Triathlon: Evidence from a COVID-19 Start-Format Discontinuity
title_zh: 大规模出发铁人三项中的跟风与搭便车：基于COVID-19出发形式断点的证据
title_primary: 大规模出发铁人三项中的跟风与搭便车：基于COVID-19出发形式断点的证据
title_secondary: Drafting and Free-Riding in Mass-Start Triathlon: Evidence from a COVID-19 Start-Format Discontinuity
official: 官方在线 2026-06-02 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Drafting in the swim leg of mass-start triathlon transfers a hydrodynamic cost advantage to the bike and run, where it surfaces as a change in relative rank. I use cross-stage rank improvement as a reverse proxy for free-riding and study its determinants in a ten-year panel of athlete × event records centred on 2020, when COVID-19 response policies replaced mass starts with individually staggered starts and mechanically curtailed drafting. A compact two-stage contest model, in which drafting enters the bike–run stage as a multiplicative cost shifter, organises the predictions. Identification combines pooled OLS with athlete and event fixed effects and a sharp regression-discontinuity design at the 2019/2020 cut-off. Free-riding was substantial before 2020, fell sharply in 2020 (a local-linear RDD estimate of about −31 rank places; a local-cubic estimate of about −92), and recovered only partially afterwards. The gains are largest for weaker swimmers and deeper drafting positions, the gender gap is modest, and they rise with swim-group size at an estimated log–log elasticity of about 0.43. The 2020 disruption thus acts as a contraction of the feasible set for free-riding, and its recovery is uneven rather than broad-based.
abstract_zh: 在集体出发游泳赛段中跟游所产生的流体力学成本优势会转移至自行车与跑步阶段，并表现为相对排名的变化。本文以跨赛段排名提升作为搭便车行为的反向代理指标，基于以2020年为中心的十年期运动员×赛事面板数据，研究其决定因素——2020年新冠疫情应对政策将集体出发改为间隔出发，从机制上限制了跟游行为。通过构建紧凑的两阶段竞赛模型（将跟游作为乘数型成本转移因子纳入自行车-跑步阶段）来组织预测。识别策略结合了混合OLS回归、运动员与赛事固定效应，以及以2019/2020年为断点的锐化回归断点设计。2020年前搭便车现象显著，2020年急剧下降（局部线性RDD估计值约为-31个排名位次；局部立方估计值约为-92），此后仅部分恢复。游泳能力较弱的运动员和跟游位置更靠后的选手获益最大，性别差异较小，且收益随游泳组规模扩大而增加（估计对数-对数弹性约为0.43）。因此，2020年的冲击相当于收缩了搭便车的可行集，其恢复呈现非均衡特征而非全面复苏。

title: Price discrimination under minimum advertised price restriction
title_zh: 最低广告价格限制下的价格歧视
title_primary: 最低广告价格限制下的价格歧视
title_secondary: Price discrimination under minimum advertised price restriction
authors: Danial Asmat, Jake Kramer, Chenyu Yang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A minimum advertised price (MAP) policy is a popular vertical restraint. We study retail pricing under MAP using price data of Seagate hard disk drives on US online retailers. The data suggest that MAP is not a form of minimum resale price maintenance (RPM). First, we find that retail prices are often lower than MAP. Second, retail prices of products subject to MAP have greater dispersions between retailers. Lastly, some retail prices can increase after a MAP decrease. These observations are consistent with the predictions of a search model that interprets MAP as a form of information restraint.
abstract_zh: 最低广告价格（MAP）政策是一种常见的纵向约束。我们利用美国在线零售商希捷硬盘驱动器的价格数据，研究MAP下的零售定价。数据显示，MAP并非最低转售价格维持（RPM）的一种形式。首先，我们发现零售价格往往低于MAP。其次，受MAP约束的产品在零售商之间的零售价格差异更大。最后，某些零售价格可能在MAP下调后上升。这些观察结果与将MAP视为一种信息约束的搜索模型的预测相符。

title: Urban community-led total sanitation: opportunities, barriers and lessons from Nanded, India
title_zh: 城市社区主导的全面环境卫生：来自印度南德的机会、障碍与经验
title_primary: 城市社区主导的全面环境卫生：来自印度南德的机会、障碍与经验
title_secondary: Urban community-led total sanitation: opportunities, barriers and lessons from Nanded, India
authors: Lyla Mehta, Ruth Kennedy-Walker, Apeksha Vohra, Tanvi Bhatkal, Pallavi Harshe 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: • There is a strong interplay between caste, gender, class and the sanitation crisis in rapidly urbanising areas. • The worst affected are marginalised residents as well as sanitation workers and migrants. • Local action and communities alone cannot address problems of faecal sludge and wastewater management. • CLTS programmes need to address second and third generation challenges as well as sustainability and equity. • Safely managed sanitation needs to be a political priority in rapidly urbanising areas. This article focuses on the sanitation challenges of rapidly urbanizing localities in the global South by drawing on the case of Nanded city in Maharashtra, India. Nanded had a short-lived experiment with urban Community-led Total Sanitation (CLTS) between 2011 and 2012 and is today officially considered to be highly successful in urban sanitation according to India’s Clean India Mission. However, in reality many challenges remain, especially for its marginalised residents especially around sewage, waste and faecal sludge management (FSM) (considered to be second and third generation challenges). The article thus seeks to: (1) Trace the story of CLTS implementation, its successes, legacy and limitations; and (2) Examine urban sanitation challenges that are often missed in official programmes especially with respect to marginality, waste, co-production and community action. Through qualitative research methods and two phases of research, first in 2012 and then between 2022 and 2024, we explore past and current perceptions and experiences of diverse communities around sanitation, waste and CLTS. We argue that while there is strong potential for urban sanitation programmes inspired by CLTS to positively improve sanitation in urban areas, they need to recognise historical and current drivers of marginality around class, caste, gender and geography that continue to shape sanitation access and safety. The focus of urban sanitation programmes also need to go beyond toilets and behaviour change programmes, largely targeted at poor and marginalised residents, to also address waste and faecal sludge management problems which cannot be tackled at the community level. Finally, to systematically tackle second and third-generation sanitation challenges, community action must be accompanied by institutional change, state buy-in, investment and co-production engaging different actors, from state agencies to citizens and other stakeholders. The findings have relevance for everybody seeking to achieve safe and equitable urban sanitation for all in rapidly urbanising contexts.
abstract_zh: • 在快速城市化地区，种姓、性别、阶级与环境卫生危机之间存在强烈的相互作用。• 受影响最严重的是边缘化居民以及环卫工人和移民。• 仅靠地方行动和社区无法解决粪便污泥和废水管理问题。• 社区主导的总环境卫生（CLTS）计划需要应对第二代和第三代挑战，以及可持续性和公平性问题。• 安全管理的环境卫生需要成为快速城市化地区的政治优先事项。本文以印度马哈拉施特拉邦南德市为例，聚焦全球南方快速城市化地区面临的环境卫生挑战。南德在2011年至2012年间曾短暂试行城市社区主导的总环境卫生（CLTS），如今根据印度“清洁印度使命”的评估，该市在官方上被视为城市环境卫生方面高度成功的典范。然而，现实中仍存在诸多挑战，尤其是针对其边缘化居民，特别是在污水、垃圾和粪便污泥管理（FSM）方面（被视为第二代和第三代挑战）。因此，本文旨在：（1）追溯CLTS实施的过程、其成就、遗产和局限性；（2）审视官方计划中常被忽视的城市环境卫生挑战，特别是在边缘性、废弃物、共同生产和社区行动方面。通过定性研究方法，并在两个研究阶段（第一阶段为2012年，第二阶段为2022年至2024年间）中，我们探讨了不同社区围绕环境卫生、废弃物和CLTS的过去与当前的认知和经历。我们认为，尽管受CLTS启发的城市环境卫生计划在改善城市环境卫生方面具有巨大潜力，但它们需要认识到围绕阶级、种姓、性别和地理的历史及当前边缘化驱动因素，这些因素持续影响着环境卫生的可及性和安全性。城市环境卫生计划的重点也需超越主要针对贫困和边缘化居民的厕所建设和行为改变计划，同时解决无法在社区层面应对的废弃物和粪便污泥管理问题。最后，为系统性地应对第二代和第三代环境卫生挑战，社区行动必须伴随制度变革、政府支持、投资以及与不同行为者（从政府机构到公民及其他利益相关者）的共同生产。这些发现对在快速城市化背景下寻求实现人人享有安全且公平的城市环境卫生的所有相关方具有参考意义。

title: Treatment effects with targeting instruments
title_zh: 使用目标工具的处理效应
title_primary: 使用目标工具的处理效应
title_secondary: Treatment effects with targeting instruments
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Multivalued treatments are commonplace in applications. We explore the use of discrete-valued instruments to control for selection bias in this setting. Our discussion revolves around the concept of targeting: which instruments target which treatments. It allows us to establish conditions under which counterfactual averages and treatment effects are point- or partially-identified for composite complier groups. We explore the additional identifying power of a positive selection assumption. We illustrate its usefulness by revisiting the findings of Kline and Walters (2016) on the Head Start Impact Study. We derive informative bounds that suggest less beneficial effects of Head Start expansions than their parametric estimates.
abstract_zh: 多值处理在应用中十分常见。我们探讨在此背景下使用离散值工具变量来控制选择偏差的问题。我们的讨论围绕“靶向”概念展开：即哪些工具变量针对哪些处理。这使我们能够建立条件，在这些条件下，反事实平均值和处理效应对于复合依从者群体可以是点识别或部分识别的。我们进一步探讨了正向选择假设的额外识别力。通过重新审视Kline和Walters（2016）关于“启智计划影响研究”的发现，我们展示了其有用性。我们推导出信息丰富的边界，这些边界表明启智计划扩展的有益效果低于其参数估计所显示的水平。

title: Does Information Change Consumer Beliefs and Valuation of Cage‐Free Egg Systems? Evidence From an Artefactual Field Experiment
title_zh: 信息是否改变了消费者对散养鸡蛋系统的信念和估值？来自人工实地实验的证据
title_primary: 信息是否改变了消费者对散养鸡蛋系统的信念和估值？来自人工实地实验的证据
title_secondary: Does Information Change Consumer Beliefs and Valuation of Cage‐Free Egg Systems? Evidence From an Artefactual Field Experiment
authors: Kofi Britwum, Kelly A. Davidson, John C. Bernard, Michelle Segovia, Christopher R. Gustafson
official: 官方在线 2026-03-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Cage‐free egg production systems, in addition to its namesake, include pasture‐raised and certified organic eggs. Rising consumer concerns about animal welfare have increased demand for these options, yet little is known about the extent to which consumers understand these product distinctions and how information may influence their beliefs and willingness to pay. This study used an incentivized, artefactual field experiment to elicit preferences and beliefs regarding hen welfare, environmental impacts, and nutritional quality across production systems, both before and after information provision. The results indicate that information attenuated beliefs about the welfare and nutritional benefits of cage‐free systems, while increasing beliefs about various benefits of pasture‐raised and certified organic eggs. Price premiums increased for pasture‐raised eggs and decreased for cage‐free and conventional eggs.
abstract_zh: 摘要 无笼鸡蛋生产系统，除其名称所示外，还包括牧场散养和认证有机鸡蛋。消费者对动物福利日益增长的关注提升了对这些选项的需求，然而，关于消费者对这些产品差异的理解程度以及信息如何影响其信念和支付意愿，目前知之甚少。本研究采用一项激励性的、人工实地实验，在信息提供前后，分别引出了消费者对不同生产系统下蛋鸡福利、环境影响及营养品质的偏好和信念。结果表明，信息削弱了关于无笼系统福利和营养益处的信念，同时增强了对牧场散养和认证有机鸡蛋各种益处的信念。牧场散养鸡蛋的价格溢价上升，而无笼鸡蛋和常规鸡蛋的价格溢价则下降。

title: 70 years of Scottish National Accounts: 1948–2018
title_zh: 苏格兰国民账户70年：1948–2018
title_primary: 苏格兰国民账户70年：1948–2018
title_secondary: 70 years of Scottish National Accounts: 1948–2018
authors: Graeme Roy, Niall G. MacKenzie, Sandy Stewart
official: 官方在线 2026-02-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive time series of historical National Accounts for Scotland (onshore and offshore) from 1948 to 2018. It includes a detailed breakdown by income component and industrial sector using methods that are forward and backward compatible. Through this work we offer new insights on the performance of the post‐war Scottish economy, including its relative performance to the UK and its industrial makeup. Our findings also provide, for the first time, a full picture of the totality of Scotland's economy over the last 70 years by incorporating an estimate of North Sea oil and gas gross value added from within Scotland's territorial waters.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了苏格兰（陆上与海上）自1948年至2018年的历史国民账户综合时间序列数据。该序列按收入构成和产业部门进行了详细分解，采用的方法既向前兼容又向后兼容。通过这项工作，我们对战后苏格兰经济的表现提供了新的见解，包括其相对于英国的表现及其产业结构。我们的研究结果还首次通过纳入苏格兰领海内北海石油和天然气总增加值的估算，全面展示了苏格兰过去70年经济的整体面貌。
